chapter_seo_title: Han Li Battles Slow Cultivation Progress - Chapter 7
chapter_meta_description: Han Li struggles with a mysterious cultivation technique, progressing slowly while his peer Zhang Tie shows no results at all. The sect's inner disciple test looms, and he must decide whether to persist or give up.
og_description: Han Li's cultivation pace is agonizingly slow, but a surprising revelation from Zhang Tie gives him new resolve. The sect's inner disciple test looms ahead.
twitter_description: Han Li faces his first real cultivation bottleneck. Will sheer persistence be enough to earn inner disciple status?
